'''Neva Kee's Custom Podracer''' was a modified<ref name="Star Wars: Scum and Villainy">''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]''</ref> [[FG 8T8-T]]<ref name="EV" /> operated by the [[Xamster]] [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]], [[Neva Kee]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo]] during the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY]]. 

==History==
In the [[Standard year|year]] [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas-Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Neva Kee took his podracer to the planet [[Tatooine]] to participate in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]]. [[Pilot]]ing the mottled [[Color|blue-green]], inverted Y-shaped [[podracer]], Kee began the race in the last row.<ref name="TPM" />

Kee performed poorly from the start, and was soon passed by [[Anakin Skywalker]], who had actually stalled and gotten a late start.<ref name="TPM" /> Kee flew off of the [[Mos Espa podrace circuit|course]] in search of a shortcut during the second lap and was never seen again.<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> Following his disappearance, [[Law enforcement agency|police]] [[inspector]] [[Tanivos Exantor Divo]] acquired a [[hologram]] image implicating [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] and [[bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing]] in the disappearance of Kee and his podracer. However, the hologram had been scrubbed, making its authenticity questionable.<ref name="Star Wars: Scum and Villainy" />
